question: Let the function $f:[0,1]\to\mathbb{R}$ be defined as $f(x)=\max\left\{\frac{|x-y|}{x+y+1}:0\le y\le1\right\}$ for $0\le x\le1$. Then which of the following statements is correct?

options.A: $f$ is strictly increasing on $[0,\frac12]$ and strictly decreasing on $[\frac12,1]$.
options.B: $f$ is strictly decreasing on $[0,\frac12]$ and strictly increasing on $[\frac12,1]$.
options.C: $f$ is strictly increasing on $[0,\frac{\sqrt3-1}{2}]$ and strictly decreasing on $[\frac{\sqrt3-1}{2},1]$.
options.D: $f$ is strictly decreasing on $[0,\frac{\sqrt3-1}{2}]$ and strictly increasing on $[\frac{\sqrt3-1}{2},1]$.
